hints.title: Evaluating Sum Invariance
hints.text: Analyze the fixed digit sums and count the remaining wildcard slots across the left and right halves.

hints.title: Pairwise Balancing Principle
hints.text: Bob can neutralize pairs of wildcards on the same side by choosing numbers that sum to 9 with Alice's picks.

hints.title: Mathematical Victory Condition
hints.text: Alice wins unless the net difference in wildcards is even and compensates for the sum difference by exactly 9 times half the wildcard delta.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass sum accumulation and parity comparison.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating minimax game trees has exponential branching factor due to multiple question mark values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Symmetric pairing strategy allows resolving game outcome in O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should deduce that Bob only wins when question mark difference balances sum difference with average 4.5.
